title: Thirty Days Off Social Media

pre.en: How many other people liked Hannah's photo on day 31?
pre.zh: 第 31 天 Hannah 发的照片，除了她自己还有几个人点赞？

intro: 一段演讲：Rota 的产品经理 Hannah 讲她删掉所有社交 App 三十天的经历。她讲自己的事，不说教，最后对在场做设计的人说了几句，结尾落在一个画面上。读的时候留意情态被动：is designed to、can be used to、should be built，说东西是用来干什么的、该怎么做。

sentences.en: As a product manager, I know exactly how apps keep us busy.
sentences.zh: 我是做产品经理的，App 是怎么让我们停不下来的，我再清楚不过。

sentences.en: That little red dot is designed to make you tap.
sentences.zh: 那个小红点，就是专门设计来让你点的。

sentences.en: And endless feeds are built so that you never reach the bottom.
sentences.zh: 没有尽头的信息流，也是故意做成让你永远刷不到底的。

sentences.en: Knowing all this didn't help, though.
sentences.zh: 可知道这些也没用。

sentences.en: By February this year, I was completely hooked on my phone.
sentences.zh: 到今年二月，我已经彻底离不开手机了。

sentences.en: I'd browse through my feed on the way to work, at lunch, in bed.
sentences.zh: 上班路上刷，午饭时刷，躺床上也刷。

sentences.en: I even checked it at traffic lights, just out of habit.
sentences.zh: 连等红灯都要看一眼，纯粹是习惯了。

sentences.en: So on the first of March, I deleted every social media app to see what would happen.
sentences.zh: 所以 3 月 1 号，我把所有社交 App 都删了，看看会怎么样。

sentences.en: In the first week, I was sure I was missing out on everything.
sentences.zh: 第一个星期，我总觉得自己错过了所有事。

sentences.en: My cousin got engaged, and I heard about it from my mum two days later.
sentences.zh: 我表妹订婚了，我是两天后才从我妈那儿听说的。

sentences.en: I was gutted.
sentences.zh: 我难受死了。

sentences.en: To be honest, I had serious doubts about the whole idea.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我很怀疑这么做到底有没有用。

sentences.en: My hand still reached for my phone as soon as I sat down.
sentences.zh: 一坐下来，手还是会去摸手机。

sentences.en: By the third week, though, things had changed.
sentences.zh: 可到了第三个星期，情况变了。

sentences.en: I'd got through two novels on the bus.
sentences.zh: 我在公交车上读完了两本小说。

sentences.en: One was an old book my grandad had handed down to me.
sentences.zh: 其中一本是爷爷留给我的旧书。

sentences.en: I started taking my time over dinner, and I could actually taste it.
sentences.zh: 吃晚饭我开始慢慢吃，真的尝出了味道。

sentences.en: But what's stuck in my mind most is the bus.
sentences.zh: 不过我印象最深的，还是公交车。

sentences.en: I was the only person looking out of the window.
sentences.zh: 整车人只有我一个在看窗外。

sentences.en: I also learned that a phone can be used to call people.
sentences.zh: 我还发现，手机原来是可以用来给人打电话的。

sentences.en: My mum had been telling me that for years.
sentences.zh: 这话我妈跟我说了好多年了。

sentences.en: Going without likes was much easier than I'd thought.
sentences.zh: 没有点赞的日子，比我想的容易多了。

sentences.en: So, for any designers listening, apps should be built to let people leave, not just to keep them.
sentences.zh: 所以，给正在听的设计师们说一句：App 应该做得让人走得开，而不只是想方设法留住人。

sentences.en: Look out for the red dots in your own work, because most of them can be removed.
sentences.zh: 留意一下你们自己产品里的小红点，大部分其实都可以去掉。

sentences.en: My team's just launched Rota, an app named after the chore list on my fridge.
sentences.zh: 我的团队刚上线了 Rota，名字就来自我家冰箱上那张家务表。

sentences.en: I asked them to keep it boring.
sentences.zh: 我让他们把它做得无聊一点。

sentences.en: On day 31, I posted a photo of the three books I'd read that month.
sentences.zh: 第 31 天，我发了一张照片，是这个月读完的三本书。

sentences.en: It got four likes.
sentences.zh: 一共四个赞。

sentences.en: One of them was mine.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是我自己点的。

cards.note: end + less；同类词 useless、homeless。
to like something so much that you find it hard to stop doing or using it
cards.tip: 口语说法，比 addicted to 轻松；后面接名词或 doing：be hooked on playing chess。
cards.example: My dad is hooked on a TV quiz show.

cards.note: to look through a website, a feed, a magazine or a shop without looking for anything special
cards.tip: 说的是随便看看、不找特定的东西；在店里「只是看看」说 I'm just browsing。
cards.example: I browsed through a few cookbooks while I waited.

cards.note: 动词 feed 是「喂」；新闻推送也叫 news feed。
because you always do it, not because you have decided to
cards.tip: out of 在这里表示原因，同类说法还有 out of interest（出于好奇）、out of kindness。
cards.example: I still set my alarm for six out of habit, even on Sundays.

cards.note: 删 App 也常说 uninstall；名词 deletion。
to not have the chance to enjoy something that other people are enjoying
cards.tip: on 后面接错过的东西；没有宾语时说 miss out：I don't want to miss out。
cards.example: Don't miss out on the free tickets — they go fast.

cards.note: 英式电话占线也说 engaged：The line is engaged。
to feel very disappointed and sad about something
cards.tip: 英式口语，比 disappointed 语气重得多；正式场合别用。
cards.example: He was gutted when his team lost in the final minute.

cards.note: to feel not sure whether something is right or true
cards.tip: doubts 常用复数；程度可以加 serious、some。
cards.example: I had doubts about the flat until I saw the garden.

cards.zh: 读完；用完；做完（一定量的东西）
cards.note: to finish or use a large amount of something
cards.tip: 英式过去分词用 got：had got through。另一个常见意思是「熬过（难关）」：get through a hard week。
cards.example: We got through three pots of tea during the meeting.

cards.note: 小说家是 novelist；短篇小说是 short story。
to give something to a younger person in your family
to do something slowly and carefully without hurrying

cards.zh: 让人一直记得；印在脑子里
cards.note: if something sticks in your mind, you remember it for a long time
cards.tip: 主语是被记住的事；stick 的过去式、过去分词是 stuck。
cards.example: Her advice has stuck in my mind for years.

cards.note: to manage without something that you usually have or want
cards.tip: 后面接名词；比 do without 更强调「缺了它、忍一忍」。
cards.example: I went without coffee for a week, and I was terrible company.

cards.note: g 不发音，读 /dɪˈzaɪnə/。
to watch carefully so that you will notice something or someone
比 take away 正式；名词 removal。
to be given the same name as someone or something
